headline_correction: A previous run reported that 2,014 UK venues "have no website". That statement was FALSE. It only meant that no URL happened to be embedded in evidence already stored on the venue record. Of the 257 venues actually researched in this package, 145 (56.4%) have a real, validated official web presence (venue site or official operator venue page) after the writer re-fetched and identity-checked every claimed URL. The other 1,766 venues of the estate were NOT researched and must never be counted as negatives - see not-yet-researched.json.
